violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --During storage and time of inactivity, food should be protected and stored in manner that does not become an attractant to pests and vermin.

Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Nonfood contact surface of clean in place equipment * was not cleaned properly. . Ice chest found with standing water. Ice chests should be drained, cleaned, and sanitized after use to prevent the growth of bacteria.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. . Floors and walls should be cleaned after each use to prevent an environment that is welcoming to pests and vermin
Control of insects, rodents, and other pests. — --Discussed fly control while the unit is in storage and not being used. Flies were abundant inside the unit.
